articles.body_text: Federal prosecutors unsealed an indictment charging Daniel Okafor, 41, with wire fraud and money laundering, alleging that invoices issued through his import business overstated shipments so that payments could be moved for third parties. Okafor, whose date of birth is recorded in the filing as 4 March 1985, was arrested on Monday and released on bond. The filing names Kestrel Trading FZE as a counterparty on several of the invoices under investigation.
articles.headline: Importer Daniel Okafor indicted in trade invoice fraud case

articles.body_text: Winger Daniel Okafor, 28, has signed a two-year contract after a breakout season, the club announced. Okafor, born 17 June 1998, joined the academy at fourteen and broke into the first team last spring. His agent said several clubs had made enquiries before the deal was agreed.
articles.headline: Daniel Okafor signs two-year deal after breakout season

articles.body_text: Kestrel Trading FZE, a free-zone trading company registered in the Emirates under registration REG-AE-99120, has been named in reporting on sanctions evasion through layered trade invoices. Investigators described a front company structure used to move sanctioned goods, and said export controls filings are under review by the regulator.
articles.headline: Kestrel Trading FZE named in sanctions evasion reporting

articles.body_text: Viktor Petrov was sentenced to nine years in prison after being convicted of racketeering and drug trafficking offences linked to an organised crime syndicate. The court heard that Petrov directed couriers across three countries over four years. He was arrested in a raid last year and convicted in March.
articles.headline: Viktor Petrov convicted in organised crime sentencing

articles.body_text: Daniel Okafor, who opened a bakery in Bend three years ago, has won a regional small business award for community employment. Okafor employs fourteen people and supplies two school districts. The award panel cited the bakery's apprenticeship scheme for young bakers.
articles.headline: Bakery owner Daniel Okafor wins regional small business award
